title: AM/PM selection
body: On the app, the am/pm selection doesn’t work, just a heads up! But a great app I’ve started building a routine and been using for a few days, The alarm function is great for reminding me! But unfortunately only in the mornings :)
author: 5pies

title: Awesome!
body: Love that you can set up reminders that pop up, hoping this will help me build up a routine to remember taking my supplements!
author: Annasllgs
